tools.name: x_amz_bedrock_agentcore_search
tools.description: A special tool that returns a trimmed down list of tools given a context. Use this tool only when there are many tools available and you want to get a subset that matches the provided context.

sourceId.description: Candles source ID. Default: 4002. Use list_pricing_sources for others.

interval.description: Interval in MILLISECONDS (NOT seconds!). Values: 60000 (1min), 3600000 (1hr), 86400000 (1day). Default: 60000.

units.description: Currency units for output. "native" (default) or "usd". USD units only available for spot instruments.

tools.name: pricing___get_candles
tools.description: OHLCV candles. Supports 1min (60000), 1hr (3600000), 1day (86400000) intervals. Use units="usd" for USD-denominated values (spot only).

sourceId.description: Derivative source ID. Use list_pricing_sources first to find derivative exchanges. This endpoint returns the source's entire coverage list and has no limit or paging parameter, so responses for a large source run to several megabytes. Prefer get_source_details_by_product, which accepts baseAsset and counterAsset filters, when you only need part of the coverage.

tools.name: pricing___get_derivative_source_details
tools.description: Get derivative source details (futures, options, perpetuals).

sourceId.description: Derivative source ID. Use list_pricing_sources first.

entityDerivativeCode.description: Entity derivative code/ticker. Example: "BTC-PERPETUAL". One of lukkaDerivativeCode or entityDerivativeCode must be supplied.

limit.description: Max records to return. Not currently honoured: a request with limit:1 returned 273 records, and the response carries no count field and does not echo the limit, so a caller cannot detect that it was ignored. The API owner has confirmed a fix is coming for the parameter itself but has deliberately ruled out giving it a default value, because existing quant consumers read this endpoint unbounded - so expect to keep passing an explicit limit, and expect no default even after the fix lands. Bound the response with `from`/`to` in the meantime.

lukkaDerivativeCode.description: Lukka derivative code. Example: "BTC-PERPETUAL.DERI". One of lukkaDerivativeCode or entityDerivativeCode must be supplied.

to.description: End timestamp. Format: ISO 8601. Defaults to now.

tools.name: pricing___get_historical_derivative_trades
tools.description: Historical trade data for derivatives (futures, options, perpetuals).

sourceId.description: Index source ID. Index sources are numbered 6xxx; call list_pricing_sources to see which index sources are available. 5001 and 5002 are reference rates, not indices - query those through get_latest_prices or get_historical_prices. 3000 is Hourly Prices, also not an index.

pairCode.description: Trading pair filter. Format: BASE-COUNTER. Example: "XBT-USD".

limit.description: Max records to return. Defaults to 1440.

fill.description: Forward fill gaps with last known price. Defaults to false.

tools.name: pricing___get_historical_index_prices
tools.description: Index price data. Index sources are numbered 6xxx; call list_pricing_sources to see which index sources are available. Do NOT pass a Lukka aggregate source here: the Lukka Reference Rate (5001) and Median Reference Rate (5002) are reference rates, not indices, and are served by get_latest_prices and get_historical_prices instead.

sourceId.description: Source ID. Use list_pricing_sources for exchange IDs. Also serves the Lukka aggregate marks and reference rates: 1000 EOD, 2000 Intraday, 3000 Hourly, 5001 Lukka Reference Rate, 5002 Lukka Median Reference Rate.

limit.description: Max number of prices. Defaults to 1440. Max: 1440.

from.description: Start timestamp. Format: ISO 8601. Example: "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z". Defaults to 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z. Truncated to minute.

interval.description: Interval in MILLISECONDS (NOT seconds!). Values: 60000 (1min), 86400000 (1day). NO hourly for prices - use get_candles.

to.description: End timestamp. Format: ISO 8601. Example: "2024-01-31T23:59:59Z". Defaults to now. Truncated to minute.

fill.description: Forward fill gaps with last known price. Defaults to false.

tools.name: pricing___get_historical_prices
tools.description: Historical price time series for a pair on a pricing source.

sourceId.description: Derivative source ID. Use list_pricing_sources first to find derivative exchanges.

asOf.description: Historical timestamp. Format: ISO 8601. Defaults to now.

tools.name: pricing___get_latest_derivative_trades
tools.description: Latest derivative trades (futures, options, perpetuals).

sourceId.description: Index source ID. Index sources are numbered 6xxx; call list_pricing_sources to see which index sources are available. 5001 and 5002 are reference rates, not indices - query those through get_latest_prices or get_historical_prices. 3000 is Hourly Prices, also not an index.

lookback.description: Lookback window in ms. Example: 3600000 (1 hour)

tools.name: pricing___get_latest_index_prices
tools.description: Index price data. Index sources are numbered 6xxx; call list_pricing_sources to see which index sources are available. Do NOT pass a Lukka aggregate source here: the Lukka Reference Rate (5001) and Median Reference Rate (5002) are reference rates, not indices, and are served by get_latest_prices and get_historical_prices instead.

pairCodes.description: Comma-separated pairs. Examples: "XBT-USD", "XBT-USD,ETH-USD,ADA-USD". Defaults to all pairs available on the source.

asOf.description: Snapshot timestamp. Format: ISO 8601. Defaults to latest available.

order.description: Sort direction by market cap. Omit for a top-N list: the API default is DESC, so rank 1 (largest) comes first. Passing ASC returns the SMALLEST assets first (rank ~1970), which is rarely what a caller wants - it sorts by market cap ascending, not by rank ascending.

tools.name: pricing___get_latest_market_caps
tools.description: Latest market cap snapshot with ranking across pairs. Shows top coins by market cap.

sortBy.description: Sort field. The only value verified to work is `volume`, and only with marketType SPOT. Everything else tested returns 400 `Unsupported sorting field: <value>`, including `price` and `marketCap` (both previously documented as accepted) and `volumeUsd24h` and `volume24h` (which appear as response fields but are not sort keys). On marketType DERIVATIVE even `volume` is rejected and no working sort key is known, so omit this parameter there - the call succeeds without it.

sourceIds.description: Required: comma-separated source IDs. Example: "4001,4002,4005". Use list_pricing_sources first.

tools.name: pricing___get_latest_markets
tools.description: Latest market data for spot or derivative markets. Requires sourceIds.

sourceId.description: Source ID. Use list_pricing_sources for exchange IDs. Also serves the Lukka aggregate marks and reference rates: 1000 EOD, 2000 Intraday, 3000 Hourly, 5001 Lukka Reference Rate, 5002 Lukka Median Reference Rate.

pairCodes.description: Comma-separated pairs. Examples: "XBT-USD", "XBT-USD,ETH-USD". Defaults to all pairs for the source. Mind 2048 char URL limit.

asOf.description: Historical timestamp. Format: ISO 8601. Example: "2024-01-15T12:00:00Z". Defaults to now.

lookback.description: Lookback window in ms. Default: 172800000 (2 days). Min: 1, Max: 31556952000 (1 year)

fields.description: Additional fields in output. Values: "partitions" (for Lukka Reference Rate)

tools.name: pricing___get_latest_prices
tools.description: Latest prices for the requested pairs on a pricing source.

fill.description: Forward fill gaps. Defaults to false.

tools.name: pricing___get_market_capitalization
tools.description: Market cap history for a pair. Uses Lukka Prime pricing plus circulating supply from Reference Data.

aggLookback.description: Aggregation lookback in ms. Default: 3600000 (1 hour)

sourceIds.description: Required: Comma-separated source IDs. Example: "4001,4002". Use list_pricing_sources first.

tools.name: pricing___get_market_depth
tools.description: Aggregated order book liquidity for spot pairs. This endpoint covers SPOT instruments; the instrument type is fixed in the path.

from.description: Start timestamp, ISO 8601. Example: "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z". IMPORTANT: the API defaults this to 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z when omitted, so a call with no range returns the OLDEST 1440 minutes in the series - January 2014 for XBT-USD, not recent data. That is deliberate on the API side so a caller can page forward from the beginning, but it means omitting the range silently yields decade-old prices. Always pass an explicit window. Truncated to the minute.

to.description: End timestamp, ISO 8601. Example: "2024-01-31T23:59:59Z". Pass this together with `from`: see the note on `from` about the 1970 default, which makes an unbounded call return the oldest data rather than the newest.

tools.name: pricing___get_market_variances
tools.description: Price history with exchange-level variances. Shows principal exchange and per-exchange price/volume data.

asOf.description: Snapshot timestamp. Format: ISO 8601. Defaults to now.

tools.name: pricing___get_order_book_snapshot
tools.description: Reconstructed L2 order book state at 15-second intervals. Shows bids/asks at a point in time. This endpoint covers SPOT instruments; the instrument type is fixed in the path.

sourceId.description: Source ID. Use list_pricing_sources first for exchange IDs. High-level: 1000=EOD, 2000=Realtime, 3000=Index, 4000=MarketCap. This endpoint returns the source's entire coverage list and has no limit or paging parameter, so responses for a large source run to several megabytes. Prefer get_source_details_by_product, which accepts baseAsset and counterAsset filters, when you only need part of the coverage.

tools.name: pricing___get_source_details
tools.description: Get pricing source details by ID.

sourceId.description: Source ID. Use list_pricing_sources first. High-level: 1000=EOD, 2000=Realtime, 3000=Index.

status.description: Filter by status. Values: "active", "inactive". Default returns both.

tools.name: pricing___get_source_details_by_product
tools.description: Get source details for product type with optional asset filter.

sourceId.description: Exchange source ID. Use list_pricing_sources first. Example: 4001 for specific exchange.

from.description: Start timestamp. Format: ISO 8601. Example: "2024-01-15T12:00:00Z". Truncated to minute.

to.description: End timestamp. Format: ISO 8601. Example: "2024-01-15T13:00:00Z". Truncated to minute.

tools.name: pricing___get_spot_trades
tools.description: Spot trade transactions. Max 3600 records.

from.description: Start timestamp. Format: ISO 8601. Example: "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z". Required.

interval.description: Interval in MILLISECONDS (NOT seconds!). Default: 60000 (1min). Values: 60000, 3600000, 86400000.

to.description: End timestamp. Format: ISO 8601. Max 7 days from "from". Required.

tools.name: pricing___get_vwap
tools.description: Volume-Weighted Average Price. Max time range: 7 days.

tools.name: pricing___list_pricing_sources
tools.description: List all pricing sources (1000=EOD, 2000=realtime, 3000=index, 4000=marketcap).

tools.name: pricing___list_sources_by_product
tools.description: List sources by product type.
